name: sim_gap_goodwillie_derivative_symmetric_constraint_canonical
constraint: n-th Goodwillie derivative ∂_n F must be Σ_n-equivariant

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver: load_bearing proof of Σ_n-equivariance constraint on derivatives

sympy.reason: sympy: supportive symbolic computation for permutation symmetry verification

test_2_symmetric_trilinear_derivative.description: Symmetric trilinear derivative ∂_3 F with all permutations equal
test_2_symmetric_trilinear_derivative.interpretation: Fully symmetric trilinear functors satisfy Σ_3-equivariance

test_3_homogeneous_symmetric_polynomial_.interpretation: Symmetric polynomials are admissible as derivatives

test_neg_1_asymmetric_bilinear_not_deriv.description: Asymmetric bilinear F(X,Y) = X·Y + X^2 is not a valid derivative
test_neg_1_asymmetric_bilinear_not_deriv.interpretation: Asymmetric functors violate Σ_n-equivariance and are inadmissible

test_neg_2_weighted_asymmetric_trilinear.description: Weighted asymmetric trilinear ∂_3 F with unequal permutation coefficients
test_neg_2_weighted_asymmetric_trilinear.interpretation: Unequal treatment of permutations violates Σ_3-equivariance

test_neg_3_positional_bias_not_derivativ.description: Multilinear functor with positional bias on first argument
test_neg_3_positional_bias_not_derivativ.interpretation: Position-dependent treatment is incompatible with Σ_n-equivariance

test_boundary_1_linear_derivative_trivia.description: Linear ∂_1 F has trivial Σ_1-symmetry (no permutations)
test_boundary_1_linear_derivative_trivia.interpretation: First derivatives always satisfy symmetry vacuously

test_boundary_2_bilinear_sigma_2_permuta.description: Bilinear derivative at Σ_2 permutation boundary
test_boundary_2_bilinear_sigma_2_permuta.interpretation: Σ_2-equivariance is the minimal non-trivial symmetry

test_boundary_3_degree_3_full_sigma_3_re.description: Degree-3 derivative requires full Σ_3 permutation symmetry
test_boundary_3_degree_3_full_sigma_3_re.interpretation: Higher degrees impose increasingly strict symmetry constraints
